title: The Place at Corkscrew vs Corkscrew Shores Estero FL: Which Is Right for You? 2026
excerpt: The Place at Corkscrew usually costs less each year, even with a CDD whose bonds pay off in 2046 or 2050. Corkscrew Shores has no CDD and a 240-acre lake, but a bigger HOA of about $7,600 a year with no end date.
